name: push-up medicine ball
description: A push-up with one hand on a medicine ball and the other on the floor, adding an uneven stability challenge to the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place one hand on a stable medicine ball and the other on the floor, then step back into a plank.
Brace your core and lower your chest by bending both elbows while keeping the ball steady.
Press back up without letting your hips twist.
Complete the set, then move the ball to the other hand.
